errors.evidence: The figure contains only one line plot, not two. There is no second plot showing 'Loss ratio versus FLOPs'.

errors.text_span: In plot (a), the x-axis represents training steps on a linear scale from 0 to 1.4×10⁵, while the y-axis shows loss values ranging from 0 to 1.5.
